intent: An ancient Grashan priestess's ceremonial gown in pale ruin stone, sun gold, faded terracotta and plains green: a high stepped ziggurat crown, a fitted gold-belted bodice and a stiff bell skirt that reads from the high camera as a tall crown over a pinched waist and a wide, gold-banded hem.
requests: A flared/trapezoid panel (or cone) shape in Kit, so a stiff bell skirt can taper in one part instead of in stacked overlapping panels.
A pale stone material that stays pale under the night mood preset; Slate and Concrete render too dark, so the stone is Fabric in a stone colour.
